summary: Highlights words on a timeline: karaoke lyrics, voiced captions, timed subtitles.
overview: Highlights word by word against a timeline rather than by text match. A separate component from the plain word highlighter on purpose: that one colours every occurrence of a word the same, this one addresses words by position so the same word can highlight at one moment and not another.
useCases: Captions that follow a voice line.
Timed subtitles synced to an AudioSource.

params.tuning: One entry per word, in reading order. Populating it by hand is the slow path — the evenly-spread and JSON helpers exist for that reason.
Optional. Assigned, playback time is read from it, so the highlight follows the audio rather than a separate clock that can drift.
On reads as progressive fill, off as a single moving highlight.

gotchas.title: Timings are positional, so editing the text invalidates them
gotchas.body: Adding a word shifts every timing after it. Regenerate rather than patching by hand.
